Question B-001-019-004.

Why the correct answer is right: Amateur voice communications may use a maximum of 100% modulation.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "75%": 75% is below the permitted maximum and is not the regulatory limit in the bank.
- sourceIndex 2: "50%": 50% is also below the allowed maximum modulation percentage.
- sourceIndex 3: "90%": 90% is not the official maximum; the bank gives the full 100% value.
